newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria natl bank allots 9.8 bln ATS in repos.
newsitem.headline: Austria natl bank allots 9.8 bln ATS in repos.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Friday it had allocated 9.8 billion schillings in one-week securities repurchase agreements, or repos, at an unchanged 3.00 percent.
The central bank said 12 percent of bids were filled.
Last week, the bank allotted 5.15 billion schillings, or seven percent of bids, in one-week repos. -- Julia Ferguson, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
